mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce consumer and business spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as a robust labor market boosts consumer spending and confidence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower earnings from affected sectors.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of quarters with declining INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating increased retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns turn positive over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between a rising FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL (> 2% YoY) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as higher interest rates and inflation erode purchasing power and corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in UNRATE, indicating labor market softening, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.12).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 3-month moving average, signaling increased housing market activity, S&P 500 forward returns turn positive over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved consumer confidence and spending in the housing sector.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.
